note: Town of Redvers campground on Hwy 13 behind the log-cabin tourist booth and the Red Coat Mountie statue, beside the rec centre's pool and ball diamonds. The full-service sites (30-57) line a lane along Methuen St; sites 1-20 are treed or grassed with 30-amp power and water; sites 21-26 take rigs only to 20 ft. --Claude
